show.title: How to Pray for the Sick and Expect a Miracle
show.subtitle: The podcast of the book by Graham Marsland
show.voices: Two voices made with artificial intelligence talk through Graham Marsland’s book and the Bible, one question at a time. Everything they say comes from the book and from the Bible.

lenses.A: When you are the one who is sick
lenses.C: When you are caring for someone
lenses.D: When you have never prayed for anyone
lenses.F: When you are not sure God still heals
lenses.H: When you are getting to know Jesus

episodes.title: Does God Want Me Well?
episodes.lensTitle: When you are the one who is sick
episodes.description: At Marah the water was too bitter to drink, and there God told His people one of His names: “I am the LORD who heals you.” For anyone who is sick and wonders whether God wants them well.
episodes.picture: A piece of wood and the water at Marah

episodes.title: How Do I Pray for My Child When I Am Frightened?
episodes.lensTitle: When your child is sick
episodes.description: A father brought his son to Jesus and cried out, “I do believe; help my unbelief!” For every parent who is frightened for their child.
episodes.picture: A small flame (“I do believe; help my unbelief!”)

episodes.title: What Do I Say When I Pray for Someone I Love?
episodes.lensTitle: When you are caring for someone
episodes.description: A simple, kind way to pray for someone you love, one step at a time, and a prayer Graham prayed for his friend in a car.
episodes.picture: A flask of oil (James 5:14)

episodes.title: Is It Really My Place to Pray for the Sick?
episodes.lensTitle: When you have never prayed for anyone
episodes.description: Ananias was an ordinary follower of Jesus when God sent him to lay his hands on Saul. For anyone who thinks praying for the sick is only for pastors.
episodes.picture: Three people (every believer)

episodes.title: Is It My Fault I Am Still Sick?
episodes.lensTitle: When you are still waiting
episodes.description: For anyone who has prayed and is still sick. Why a person who is still sick is never to blame, and why it is right to keep asking.
episodes.picture: A sunrise (when you do not see it yet)

episodes.title: Does God Still Heal Today?
episodes.lensTitle: When you are not sure God still heals
episodes.description: An honest account of a young woman in Perth, as the book tells it, and why every story like it points to Jesus.
episodes.picture: One person walking against the crowd

episodes.title: How Do I Lead My Church to Pray for the Sick?
episodes.lensTitle: When you lead others
episodes.description: Jesus sent seventy-two of His followers out two by two. A simple, kind way for a church or a small group to begin praying for the sick.
episodes.picture: A road, and two people setting out

episodes.title: What Is Jesus Like?
episodes.lensTitle: When you are getting to know Jesus
episodes.description: Blind Bartimaeus kept calling out when the crowd told him to be quiet, and Jesus stopped. For anyone still finding out who Jesus is.
episodes.picture: An eye (“let me see again”)

episodes.title: What Do I Hold On To When the Symptoms Shout?
episodes.lensTitle: When you are the one who is sick
episodes.description: A Roman centurion told Jesus, “just say the word.” For anyone whose symptoms seem louder than God's promise.
episodes.picture: An open Bible (He sent His word)

episodes.title: Does God Love My Child More Than I Do?
episodes.lensTitle: When your child is sick
episodes.description: If you know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven? For every parent of a sick child.
episodes.picture: Bread and a fish (a father’s good gifts)

episodes.title: How Do I Love Them Well While They Are Sick?
episodes.lensTitle: When you are caring for someone
episodes.description: Jesus took a blind man by the hand and led him out of the village. For anyone caring for someone they love.
episodes.picture: One person leading another by the hand

episodes.title: What If I Pray and Look Foolish?
episodes.lensTitle: When you have never prayed for anyone
episodes.description: On Mount Carmel, Elijah prayed in front of everyone. For anyone afraid of looking foolish if they pray for someone.
episodes.picture: The altar and the fire on Carmel

episodes.title: How Long Do I Keep Asking?
episodes.lensTitle: When you are still waiting
episodes.description: Elijah prayed for rain and sent his servant to look towards the sea seven times. For anyone wondering whether to keep asking.
episodes.picture: A small cloud rising from the sea, and seven marks

episodes.title: What Did Jesus Carry for Us?
episodes.lensTitle: When you are not sure God still heals
episodes.description: What the Bible says Jesus carried to the cross, the friends who lowered a man through a roof, and why this truth is never a weapon.
episodes.picture: The cross

episodes.title: Why Did Jesus Heal?
episodes.lensTitle: When you lead others
episodes.description: Nobody asked Jesus for anything at the gate of Nain. He saw a widow, and He had compassion on her.
episodes.picture: A heart (moved with compassion)

episodes.title: Why Do Christians Pray “in Jesus’ Name”?
episodes.lensTitle: When you are getting to know Jesus
episodes.description: Peter said to a man named Aeneas, “Jesus Christ heals you!” What it means to pray in the name of Jesus.
episodes.picture: A crown (the name above every name)

episodes.title: Can I Reach Out to Jesus Myself?
episodes.lensTitle: When you are the one who is sick
episodes.description: A woman who had been ill for twelve years pressed through the crowd to touch Jesus' cloak. For anyone who wonders whether they can come to Jesus themselves.
episodes.picture: The cloak she touched

episodes.title: Can I Keep Asking for My Child?
episodes.lensTitle: When your child is sick
episodes.description: A mother kept asking Jesus for her daughter, and He said, “Your faith is great.” For every parent who has asked again and again.
episodes.picture: A person kneeling in prayer

episodes.title: What Do We Do After We Pray?
episodes.lensTitle: When you are caring for someone
episodes.description: Ten men with leprosy went on their way as Jesus told them, and one came back to give thanks. What to do after you have prayed.
episodes.picture: Ten, and the one who came back

episodes.title: What Do I Actually Say When I Pray?
episodes.lensTitle: When you have never prayed for anyone
episodes.description: Peter knelt and prayed, then said, “Tabitha, get up!” The simple words of a prayer for someone who is sick.
episodes.picture: A needle and thread (Tabitha)

episodes.title: What Do I Do with My Doubts?
episodes.lensTitle: When you are still waiting
episodes.description: Peter walked on the water, saw the wind and began to sink, and Jesus reached out His hand. For anyone whose doubts have crept in while they wait.
episodes.picture: A rock in the waves (Peter on the water)

episodes.title: Is Jesus Still the Same Today?
episodes.lensTitle: When you are not sure God still heals
episodes.description: A man with leprosy asked Jesus whether He was willing. Jesus touched him and said, “I am willing.” Is He the same today?
episodes.picture: An outstretched hand (“I am willing”)

episodes.title: Who Gets the Glory?
episodes.lensTitle: When you lead others
episodes.description: Peter and John at the temple gate called Beautiful, and what Peter told the crowd afterwards. Why every answered prayer points to Jesus.
episodes.picture: The gate called Beautiful

episodes.title: Where Do I Begin?
episodes.lensTitle: When you are getting to know Jesus
episodes.description: One sentence to hold on to: find what God has said in His Word, ask Him to do what He said, and expect Him to do it.
episodes.picture: A key (the key to prayer)
